layers.title: Layers - {target}
layers.subtitle.no-manifest: This pack has no manifest yet. Saving writes one.
layers.validate.crossfade: {name}: the crossfade must be between 0 and {max} seconds.
layers.validate.gap: {name}: the shortest gap cannot be longer than the longest.
layers.validate.interval: {name}: an interval layer needs at least one time.
layers.mode.label: Play mode
layers.mode.once-hint: Plays through a single time and stops.
layers.mode.loop-hint: Repeats forever. With one file it loops on itself at its own repeat point; with several it plays them one after another.
layers.mode.random-hint: Fires one file at a random gap, forever.
layers.mode.interval-hint: Fires at fixed times measured from the start of the slot.
layers.order.label: Order
layers.order.sequential-hint: Plays the files in the order listed, then starts over.
layers.order.random-hint: Draws a different file each pass.
layers.order.single-hint: One track, repeating at its own loop point. The intro plays once and the body repeats.
layers.crossfade.label: Crossfade into the next pass
layers.crossfade.hint: How long one pass overlaps the next: the outgoing file fades out while the incoming one fades in. Off cuts straight from one to the other.
layers.crossfade.aria: Crossfade into the next pass, in seconds
layers.crossfade.off: Off, so one pass cuts straight into the next
layers.wait.label: Wait for the sound to finish
layers.wait.off: Off: the gap is timed from when a sound starts, so long files can overlap.
layers.wait.on: On: the gap starts when the sound finishes, so only one plays at a time.
layers.interval.none: No times yet. Add one below.
layers.card.chance-hint: How often this layer sounds when it starts. 100% is every time.
layers.single.discard-message: Single plays one track, repeating at its own loop point. "{kept}" is kept and the other {count, plural, one {# file is} other {# files are}} removed from this layer. Nothing is written until you save.
layers.effects.label: Effects
layers.effects.hint: Applied to this layer only, top to bottom.
layers.effects.none-hint: The files play as they are
layers.effects.preset.muffled-hint: Heard through walls: highs gone, the rest dulled. For an outdoor recording used inside.
layers.effects.preset.distant-hint: Far away: both ends rolled off and the body pulled back.
layers.effects.preset.thin-hint: Small and tinny, like a radio or a phone.
layers.effects.preset.warm-hint: A little more low end, a little less fizz.
layers.effects.kind.lowpass-hint: Rolls off everything above the cutoff
layers.effects.kind.highpass-hint: Rolls off everything below the cutoff
layers.effects.kind.eq-hint: Low, mid and high, in decibels
layers.files.empty: No files. This layer will not play.
layers.files.one-only: One file only while the order is Single. Remove it to choose another, or pick Sequential or Shuffle.
layers.files.none-available: No other audio in this pack
layers.loop.label: Repeat from
layers.loop.hint: Seconds into the file that each repeat starts at. 0 repeats the whole file.
layers.loop.start: From the start, so the whole file repeats
layers.loop.from-file: The file declares {where}, so the intro plays once and then repeats from there
layers.loop.intro: Intro plays once, then repeats from {where}
